row:
We are specialist fully qualified veterinary physiotherapists covering the east Cornwall and west Devon area in the UK. We work with all animals for rehabilitation purposes, performance enhancement or for condition maintenance. 
This channel has been created for us to share some valuable resources for our current clients, but also to provide some insight into what we do and how we might be able to help your animals. 
These videos can also be found on our website: www.shorelinevetphysio.co.uk
Enjoy!
